shoes-1916.label: Source edition
shoes-1916.note: 47-minute surviving source edition; replaces the 20-minute excerpt. Running time differs from later restorations.

land-of-head-hunters.label: Source edition
land-of-head-hunters.note: 66-minute reconstruction; replaces the 17-minute excerpt. Restoration and soundtrack rights remain separately attributed to their holders.

aelita.label: Source edition
aelita.note: 111-minute original-version source; replaces the 19-minute excerpt. The sampled audio track is silent or near-silent; no replacement score is added.

gilbreth-original-films.label: Source edition
gilbreth-original-films.note: 32-minute Prelinger compilation; replaces Part I alone. The sampled audio track is silent or near-silent; no replacement score is added.

the-cut-ups.label: Source edition
the-cut-ups.note: 19-minute source of The Cut-Ups; replaces the conflicting Towers Open Fire file.

mickey-mouse-in-vietnam.label: 16mm scan · standalone short
mickey-mouse-in-vietnam.note: Standalone 16mm scan of Short Subject (Mickey Mouse in Vietnam). Replaces the mixed program and a separate copy with a decoder error when seeking.

the-kid.label: 1921 version · 68 min
the-kid.note: 68-minute Chaplin film from Wikimedia Commons; replaces the unrelated Billy the Kid Wanted. The Commons page declares U.S. public domain; this is not a worldwide clearance for all soundtrack or edition rights.

duck-and-cover.label: Federal Civil Defense edition · 4:3
duck-and-cover.note: Correctly proportioned 4:3 government-source edition; replaces the distorted portrait derivative.
